title: BattleReadyShelf Model Definition Export
description: The authoritative contract for the JSON document accepted by POST /api/v1/admin/model-definitions/import (and produced by GET /api/v1/admin/model-definitions/export). This is the canonical source of truth for this contract - other repositories producing an import document (e.g. battlereadyshelf-data / battlereadyshelf-dataset) must conform to it. It mirrors the 'ModelDefinitionExport' schema in backend/src/main/resources/openapi/openapi.yaml; if the two ever disagree, the OpenAPI spec wins and this file should be updated to match.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this export document's schema. Must equal the backend's currently supported version (see CURRENT_EXPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION in ModelDefinitionDraftService) or the import is rejected.

exportedAt.description: Set by the backend on export; ignored if present on import.

factions.description: Factions referenced by 'modelDefinitions' below. Upserted by 'externalId' directly (no draft/publish workflow - factions carry no army-building rules, purely catalogue organisation/filtering).

externalId.description: Stable identifier used to match this faction across imports.

parentFactionExternalId.description: The externalId of the parent faction (from this same 'factions' list), if any. Null/absent for a top-level faction.

externalId.description: Optional stable identifier used to match this model definition across imports instead of by name. Null for hand-authored definitions with no external source.

factionExternalId.description: The externalId of the faction (from this document's 'factions' list) this model belongs to. Null if uncategorised.

externalId.description: Optional stable identifier for this slot, used to prefer matching it across imports by id rather than by name.

name.description: Must be unique among attachmentSlots within the same modelDefinitionExportItem - wargearOptions reference slots by this name, and the backend enforces uniqueness per model definition.

externalId.description: Optional stable identifier used to prefer matching this option across imports by id.

isDefault.description: Whether this option is part of the model's default loadout.

attachmentSlotNames.description: The name(s) of the attachment slot(s), from this same modelDefinitionExportItem's 'attachmentSlots', this option fills.
